item.title: Naira records highest depreciation against US dollar as foreign reserves decline
item.description: The Naira on Friday recorded the highest depreciation against the United States Dollar this week at the official foreign exchange amid a drop in Nigeria’s external reserves. The Central Bank of Nigeria’s data on Friday showed that the naira significantly dropped to N1,464.4974 per dollar, down from N1,457.8402, extending its downward trend for the week.
